cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.description: When its delicate pride is wounded, or when the gold coin on its forehead is dirtied, it flies into a hysterical rage.

cards.name: Alolan Dugtrio
cards.description: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Alolan Exeggutor
cards.description: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

cards.name: Magmar
cards.description: When angered, it spouts brilliant fire from all over its body. It doesn’t calm down until its opponent has burned to ash.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew
cards.description: An ancient tradition of Alolan festivals, still carried on to this day, is a competition to slide Sandshrew across ice as far as one can.

cards.name: Lapras
cards.description: These Pokémon were once near extinction due to poaching. Following protective regulations, there is now an overabundance of them.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Gastly
cards.description: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: It can spontaneously become enraged. Everyone near it clears out as it rampages and the resulting loneliness makes it angrier still.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: It usually lives underground. It searches for food while boring its way through the ground at 50 miles per hour.
